title: ⚡ModernAlerts⚡| Broadcast with Modern Styles! [1.20.x - 1.21.7]
description: ModernAlert Plugin has the function to provide AutoCountdown Restarting and Maintaince as well as Broadcast which uses the InGame Title system, Text as well as Animation and Sound
body:
ModernAlert Plugin has the function to provide AutoCountdown Restarting and Maintaince as well as Broadcast which uses the InGame Title system, Text as well as Animation and Sound

## Commands
- /bc
- /maintenance (0-60s) / cancel
- /restarting (0-60s) / cancel

## Permission
- modernalerts.admin
- modernalerts.broadcast
- modernalerts.maintenance
- modernalerts.restarting
